title: MV Is it possible for heightned resolution projects to have the event hitboxes misplaced when entering playthrough?

posts.author: elang_S
posts.body:
At first I didn't think much of it but after having Mouse System Ex's hover miss the hitbox from a large margin, having my player character not being where I wanted them to be in game vs in editor, to even using the shadow tool in rpg maker mv, I now came to the conclusion that actually readjusting my aspect ratio to 1280x780p made my events kinda go haywire
I may be mistaken, so please tell me how I can take care of this problem more effectiv
